people.name: Mahazioth
people.line: Son of Heman, a musician in David's time.

translations.web: for the twenty-third to Mahazioth, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
translations.bsb: the twenty-third to Mahazioth, his sons, and his brothers—12 in all;
translations.kjv: The three and twentieth to Mahazioth, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
translations.asv: for the three and twentieth to Mahazioth, his sons and his brethren, twelve:
